create.name: Waking Up
create.bio:
Waking Up is a meditation and philosophy app started in 2018 by the writer and neuroscientist Sam Harris, building on ideas from his book of the same name. Its approach is secular and inquiry-led, and its centre of gravity is nondual practice: recognising the open, impersonal character of awareness and seeing through the sense of a separate self, with clear explanation of what each exercise is for.

The app holds several hundred hours of audio. New members usually begin with Harris's own introductory course, then move on to series by a wide range of teachers drawn from Vipassana, Zen, Tibetan Buddhism and Western contemplative circles, including Joseph Goldstein, Diana Winston, Jayasāra and John Astin, alongside talks and conversations with scientists, philosophers and scholars on subjects such as free will, the self and Stoicism. Content is grouped by tradition and theme, from loving-kindness to the art of noticing. Membership is paid yearly, with partial or full scholarships available on request, and the company gives at least a tenth of its profits to charity.

courses.title: Waking Up Membership
courses.description: Annual membership that unlocks the full audio library, from the introductory course to series by guest teachers and recorded conversations. A partial scholarship rate is offered, and a full scholarship can be requested without proof of income.
